findings: Learner overview: add a brief current gloss such as “act or move,” supported by E3 and E10. The existing overview explains 動’s construction but does not tell readers what 动 means.

In learner.overview and learner.components[1], change “the load … has no established name or pronunciation” to make clear that the dossier does not establish it. The cited evidence describes the load as an interpretation and says its name and pronunciation are not independently established here; the current wording can read as an absolute claim about what is known (X-4588fc4b4c81063655b4, X-0ccee7cb8d4eaeec2392).
